title: Mean-Square Convergence of a New Parameterized Leapfrog Scheme for Hamiltonian Systems Driven by Gaussian Process Potentials
summary: This paper establishes the mean-square convergence of a new stochastic, parameterized leapfrog scheme introduced in our companion paper Mazumder et al. (2026) for Hamiltonian systems with Gaussian process potentials. We consider a one-step numerical integrator and provide a complete, rigorous analysis under minimal regularity assumptions on the Gaussian potential. The key technical contribution is identifying and exploiting the symplectic structure ingrained in our stochastic, parameterized leapfrog method.
